critical_code_review_comments: JobApplicationsModule.jsx properly implements status workflow: New → Under Review → Shortlisted → Interview → Hired/Rejected
PressArticlesModule.jsx correctly handles article CRUD with proper validation (title required, content min 50 chars)
Press routes properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses
Feature article logic correctly unfeatures other articles when setting a new featured article
ContentPage.jsx fetches articles dynamically from API with fallback data if API fails
